item.description: ### Fixed - **No stale "needs you" when Perch starts.** If you answered or cancelled an agent's prompt while Perch was closed, Perch no longer alerts you for it when it opens again. A prompt that is still open still alerts once. - **Old Antigravity conversations stay gone.** Another app reading Antigravity's files (a backup tool, or another agent dashboard) no longer brings old conversations back into the list.
